lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the pectoral fin, organized into approximately five horizontal rows and eight vertical columns with roughly equidistant spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of moderately elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a structured nodal grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, displaying a high-contrast transition from a light superior edge to a shadowed inferior margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density cluster of high-luminance blobs located primarily at the base and mid-section of the dorsal fin, with decreasing density toward the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large, high-luminance symbiotic organism (remora) attached ventrally, appearing as a distinct elongated white feature.
